identity.description: General linear-Gaussian state-space model: latent continuous states evolve linearly with Gaussian noise and are observed through a linear-Gaussian measurement. Exact filtering (real-time state estimate), smoothing (retrospective), and forecasting — with exact, in-model handling of missing observations. Local-level and local-linear-trend DLMs and time-varying-coefficient regression are canonical instances.

optional regressors; with time-varying coefficients they enter the STATE (the TVP-regression instance)

emits.note: filtered AND smoothed state means with full Gaussian posteriors; filtered = as-of-safe, smoothed = uses the future (see leakage edge case)
